verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: Spotify requires creating an app in the Developer Dashboard and bringing your own OAuth credentials to Composio, featuring a development mode for initial testing.

composioFit.summary: Spotify is not a Composio-managed app, so you must bring your own OAuth app configuration.
whyOwnApp: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for Spotify.
You need your own Client ID and Client Secret to configure the custom auth config in Composio.

phases.name: Create Spotify App
steps: Go to the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Click on the Create an App button.
Fill in app details, accept the Developer Terms of Service, and click CREATE.
phases.handoff: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the app overview page.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps: Retrieve the redirect URI from your Composio auth config dashboard.
Add the redirect URI to your Spotify app settings.
Ensure the redirect URI uses HTTPS (or loopback IP literals like http://127.0.0.1 for local testing).
phases.handoff: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard auth config.

phases.name: Test Connection
steps: Initiate the OAuth flow using Composio or your custom application.
Authorize access to your Spotify account.
Verify token exchange and successful API calls.
phases.handoff: Your app is ready for development use.

artefacts.title: Spotify App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
App Name: Your Agent Integration
App Description: AI agent integration using Composio
Website: https://example.com
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

artefacts.title: Scope Justification Statement
artefacts.body: Our application requires access to user profile and playback states via scopes such as user-read-private, user-read-email, and playback scopes to allow the AI assistant to help users manage their Spotify listening experience.

scopes.purpose: Access your subscription details and private profile information.
Read your currently playing content and Spotify Connect devices information.

redirectRules.rule: Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address, when HTTP is permitted.
If you are using a loopback address, use explicit IPv4 or IPv6, like http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://[::1]:PORT.
localhost is not allowed as a redirect URI.

blockers.cause: An incorrect or fake Client ID was provided in the authorization request URL.
blockers.fix: Ensure the correct Client ID from your Spotify Developer Dashboard is used.
blockers.fallback: Check your Composio auth configuration credentials.

blockers.cause: Your app exceeded the Web API rate limit, which is more strictly enforced on apps in development mode.
blockers.fix: Implement a backoff-retry strategy and apply for extended quota mode if needed.

blockers.cause: The redirect URI supplied in the authorization request does not exactly match the allowlisted redirect URI in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
blockers.fix: Verify that protocols, slashes, and port numbers match exactly.
blockers.fallback: Update allowlisted redirect URIs in the dashboard.

checklist.text: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Click Create an App, fill out details, and accept the Developer Terms.
Retrieve the redirect URI from the Composio auth config dashboard.
Add the redirect URI to the Spotify app settings with exact matching rules (HTTPS or loopback IP literals).
Copy Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.
Test the OAuth connection using Composio.
